ModMetaData.name: Romance On The Rim - Wedding Fix
ModMetaData.author: JG
ModMetaData.description: Compatibility fixes for Romance On The Rim 1.6 wedding ceremonies (v1.4 diagnostic build). Restores active weddings after save/load, repairs procession pairing serialization, calculates guest attendance from RimWorld's serialized LordToil presence data, fixes the frozen time-left display at its UI source, and logs the exact role/state when RotR ejects a wedding participant.
